name: xai-video
description: Generate videos with xAI Grok Imagine and save them as MP4 files.

interface.longDescription: Adds an xai_generate_video tool that submits one billed Grok Imagine job, polls it, and saves the MP4 locally. Jobs that xAI accepted are never resubmitted automatically.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 5-second 720p video of an orange cat stretching on a windowsill, slow push-in
